NEW Tencent Hy3 is here for FREE! 

I tested Tencent Hunyuan Hy3 which is currently available on OpenRouter for Free. Hy3 is one of the best agentic models of its size punching much higher above its tier - even beating models of 2x - 5x bigger parameter size. Hy3 is currently ranked #1 among OpenRouter’s most-used tool-calling models based on weekly usage. Watch the full video to see where it performed well:
